entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet, original dark medieval fantasy ARPG, painterly realistic 2.5D pre-rendered quality, mature anatomy and believable handsome rugged face, detailed worn steel, muted crimson tabard, leather and chainmail. ONE SAME male oath knight with short dark hair and beard, sword in right hand, scarred half helmet. Twelve full-body sprites of SAME character, strict 4 columns by 3 rows equal cells, transparent background, generous empty margin in every cell, feet on common baseline within each cell, consistent scale/head/armor throughout. Side view facing RIGHT with three-quarter face, suitable for side-scrolling 2D game. Row1: neutral alert idle, walking left foot forward, walking passing pose, walking right foot forward. Row2: walking passing opposite, sword pulled back windup, sword forward slash follow-through, sweeping low sword skill. Row3: defensive glowing ward raised sword, hit recoil, fallen dead lying compact inside cell, calm idle variant. Every cell exactly one isolated character, no companions, no ground, no scenery, no frame borders, NO text, NO labels, NO watermark. Not vector, not polygonal, not cartoon, no oversized head, no big white eyes. Moody warm rim light with readable dark silhouettes. All limbs and sword must fit within their own cells. Image wide landscape sprite sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Ashen border village after a raid, burned timber cottages, shattered stone chapel, ruined carts and well, patches of dry grass, ember smoke, distant mountain castle, crows, small warm fire pockets. CAMERA: fixed side view of a broad ground plane, NOT first person, NOT isometric aerial map. Upper 0-50 percent: rich layered scenery, buildings and vista with depth. Middle/lower 50-86 percent: continuous LEVEL walkable ground across ENTIRE WIDTH, worn stone mixed with earth, subtle cracks and puddles, no giant walls/obstacles in this band. Bottom 86-100 percent: low foreground vegetation or stones framing the path. Passage continues horizontally out of left and right edges at SAME HEIGHT. No people, no creatures, no text, no UI, no map labels, no watermark, no flat vector graphics. Keep large architecture above the playable ground and decorative clutter on edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original premium dark medieval fantasy 2.5D hand-painted RPG ENEMY sprite atlas on genuinely transparent background, strict 4 columns x 3 rows equal square cells. Row1 left to right: shambling undead swordsman in torn armor; hunched grey corrupted wolf on four legs; leather-armored cult crossbowman holding compact crossbow; crimson hooded sinister priest with staff. Row2: large scarred raider with short heavy axe; heavy armored shield guard with battered tower shield; monstrous enormous ash prison warden in black armor with iron crown and chained short mace; floating shrouded spectral wraith with spectral hands. Use case: stylized-concept. A finished illustrated horizontal panoramic world map for original dark medieval fantasy RPG 'Ashen Oath' (DO NOT write title or any text). Extra wide landscape about 3:1. Rich painterly terrain with 2.5D relief, dramatic cinematic atmosphere and convincing materials, handmade illustration rather than flat icon map. Left region burned border village cottages and ruins; next dense foggy ancient forest with prisoner cart; central dark stone prison fortress and river bridges; further right abandoned gothic abbey, bell tower, graveyard and underground tomb entrance; far right looming black cathedral and ritual terrace in violet storm. A thin meandering worn trail links all ten distinct destinations from left to right across lower-middle band. Ten landmarks roughly equally spaced horizontally; generous breathing space between. Mountain ridges, river valleys, broken walls, varied trees, rocks, rolling hills, small lights and fog make world feel lived-in and dimensional. Muted blue charcoal, moss and sepia with warm amber windows. Light from upper left, hand-painted detailed dark medieval aesthetic, no giant empty highway, NO people, NO nodes, NO numbers, NO UI, NO labels, NO lettering, NO watermark. This is a continuous map backdrop, game will overlay interactive routes and nodes.

repair.note: Same-identity edit to constrain weapon/glow within grid cells.
repair.prompt: Edit this knight sprite sheet for game asset usability. Keep exactly the SAME knight identity, armor, painterly realistic style, transparent background and 4x3 layout. Correct ALL cell overflows: twelve figures, each fully contained within its own equal square cell with at least 10% transparent margin on all four edges. The sword in middle-row third cell MUST NOT extend into fourth cell: use a compact down-and-forward diagonal follow-through, bending elbow, blade pointing upward or diagonally inside cell. The fourth cell sweeping sword must also fully fit, no truncated limbs/weapons at outer image edges. Shield glow in bottom-left must fit its own cell without entering row above. Make all figures 15% smaller to achieve margins. Preserve original idle/walk/attack/guard/hit/dead pose ordering. No text or borders.

packing: Crop grid with 8px overscan, remove neighbour fragments, uniform transparent 512px cells, WebP. No faces or bodies drawn by packing code.
